mapper.select: SELECT p.id_paciente AS idPaciente, p.nombre, p.primer_apellido AS primerApellido, p.segundo_apellido AS segundoApellido, CONCAT_WS(' ', m.nombre, m.primer_apellido, m.segundo_apellido) AS medico, c.peso AS pesoActual, c.talla, c.imc AS imcActual, CASE WHEN c.imc IS NULL THEN 'Sin datos' WHEN c.imc < 18.5 THEN 'Bajo peso' WHEN c.imc < 25.0 THEN 'Normal' WHEN c.imc < 30.0 THEN 'Sobrepeso' ELSE 'Obesidad' END AS clasificacionImc FROM paciente p INNER JOIN medico m ON m.id_medico = p.id_medico LEFT JOIN consulta c ON c.id_consulta = ( SELECT id_consulta FROM consulta WHERE id_paciente = #{idPaciente} ORDER BY fecha_consulta DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.id_paciente = #{idPaciente}

SELECT ci.id_cita AS idCita, DATE_FORMAT(ci.fecha_cita, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fechaCita, DATE_FORMAT(ci.hora_cita, '%H:%i') AS horaCita, CONCAT_WS(' ', m.nombre, m.primer_apellido, m.segundo_apellido) AS medico, ci.estatus FROM cita ci INNER JOIN medico m ON m.id_medico = ci.id_medico WHERE ci.id_paciente = #{idPaciente} AND ci.estatus = 'Confirmada' AND ci.fecha_cita >= CURDATE() ORDER BY ci.fecha_cita ASC, ci.hora_cita ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fecha_consulta, '%d/%m/%Y') AS fechaConsulta, peso, imc, CASE WHEN imc IS NULL THEN 'Sin datos' WHEN imc < 18.5 THEN 'Bajo peso' WHEN imc < 25.0 THEN 'Normal' WHEN imc < 30.0 THEN 'Sobrepeso' ELSE 'Obesidad' END AS clasificacionImc FROM consulta WHERE id_paciente = #{idPaciente} ORDER BY fecha_consulta DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT d.id_dieta AS id_dieta, d.nombre_dieta AS nombre_dieta, d.total_calorias AS total_calorias FROM consulta c INNER JOIN dieta d ON d.id_dieta = c.id_dieta WHERE c.id_paciente = #{idPaciente} AND c.id_dieta IS NOT NULL AND c.id_dieta = ( SELECT id_dieta FROM consulta WHERE id_paciente = #{idPaciente} AND id_dieta IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fecha_consulta DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1

SELECT ch.nombre_categoria AS nombreCategoria, SUM(da.cantidad * a.calorias_porcion) AS caloriasCategoria FROM categoria_horario ch INNER JOIN dieta_alimento da ON da.id_categoria = ch.id_categoria AND da.id_dieta = ch.id_dieta INNER JOIN alimento a ON a.id_alimento = da.id_alimento WHERE ch.id_dieta = #{idDieta} GROUP BY ch.id_categoria, ch.nombre_categoria ORDER BY ch.id_categoria

SELECT c.id_consulta AS idConsulta, DATE_FORMAT(c.fecha_consulta, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%i') AS fechaConsulta, c.peso, c.talla, c.imc, CASE WHEN c.imc IS NULL THEN 'Sin datos' WHEN c.imc < 18.5 THEN 'Bajo peso' WHEN c.imc < 25.0 THEN 'Normal' WHEN c.imc < 30.0 THEN 'Sobrepeso' ELSE 'Obesidad' END AS clasificacionImc, d.nombre_dieta AS nombreDieta, c.observaciones FROM consulta c LEFT JOIN dieta d ON d.id_dieta = c.id_dieta WHERE c.id_paciente = #{idPaciente} ORDER BY c.fecha_consulta DESC LIMIT 1
